thread:
emma (Design): quick microcopy review for the Logs panel empty state + export action. Current empty state says `No logs found` and primary CTA is `Download`. Feels terse and a bit ambiguous about what will be included when you hit download. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/logs-empty.png :mag:

josh (Product): yup, users asked whether download = current view vs all logs. we should clarify scope (time range/filters) and give an explicit export verb.

li (Eng): implementation detail: export produces a compressed CSV of the currently applied filters and time range (up to 30 days). it runs async and we email a link when ready. we should surface that so users don't expect an instant file.

emma (Design): proposing a few short variants to test (aim: single-line + clear CTA):
1) "No logs match these filters. Export visible logs (up to 30 days). [Export CSV]"
2) "No logs found. Download the current view as CSV. We'll email the file when it's ready. [Export]"
3) "No results. Export logs for the selected range (async). [Start export]"
Which reads best and keeps button labels actionable?

tana (QA): i like 1 for clarity. button `Export CSV` is explicit. tests: ensure toast appears after starting export, verify email link content, keyboard focus flows to toast action if user triggered export via keyboard. Also verify aria-live announces export started + ETA.

josh (Product): prefer 2 but change tone: "We'll email the file" -> "We'll email you a download link". also we should avoid parentheticals if possible. maybe: `Download the current view as CSV. We'll email you a download link when it's ready.` CTA `Export` is fine.

li (Eng): keep copy short in UI and put the longer detail in an aria-describedby hidden node. runtime already returns an estimated completion time, so aria-live can announce "Export started. Estimated time: 2 minutes."

emma (Design): updated compact copy to ship: `Download the current view as CSV. We'll email you a download link.` CTA: `Export` (primary). aria note: `role=status` live region to announce start + ETA; `aria-describedby` for expanded details: "Export includes logs matching the active filters and time range, up to 30 days."

tana (QA): add test checklist to PR: 1) screen reader reads expanded description when dialog opens, 2) email contains correct filters and time range, 3) export action idempotence if clicked multiple times, 4) keyboard-only users get focus on the confirmation toast.

ui-bot: branch "logs-export-copy" created -> PR #1012

emma (Design): thanks — i'll push copy + accessibility notes into the PR and attach a mockup. :white_check_mark:
